target: Rhino 5 for Windows as shared CAD behavior underlying Matrix workflows
scope: Reading and verification map only; not a command catalog, solver specification, implementation status authority or proof of parity.
path_base: All relative file paths resolve from this ref/rhino5 directory.

source.title: Rhinoceros 5 for Windows - User's Guide
source.author: Robert McNeel & Associates
source.notices: The unmodified PDF retains its original source notices. Public availability is not a new open-source license; it is not relabeled under the project license.

page_numbering.printed: Printed Arabic body page number where present; observed body relation printed = PDF - 8
page_numbering.front_matter: PDF 1 title/copyright; PDF 3-7 contents printed iii-vii; blank separator pages have no printed body footer.

guide.method: Bundled pypdf 6.10.0 extraction; contents, headings, native hyperlink targets and printed footers checked. Selected prose anchors reviewed; Poppler render/view for listed visual pages.
guide.limits: Page location verification and selected reading only. No exhaustive tutorial, command-option/default, API or solver audit.

web.method: Web reader open/click results; content_returned means page identity/content was accessible, not HTTP live-download verification or a complete behavior/default audit.
web.official_pdf_download_verification: See SOURCES.json for independently checked official-download bytes/hash; not inferred from web-reader HTML success.

runtime.rule: Existing bounded P0/native results remain authoritative only for their stated slice; this source index neither resets them to not_run nor upgrades remaining fixtures to pass.

mandatory_workflow: Select the exact RCORE capability and existing OM9 feature ID; read the current chapter/checkpoint and this index read_next before editing behavior.

Read the mapped local guide pages, then the exact Rhino 5 command/variant help (F1 during the command or Command Help Auto-Update, PDF 23 / printed 15). For units, History and 3DM use dedicated help/API and native fixtures; guide overview is insufficient.

Record Rhino 5 Windows SR/build, template, document/model/page units, absolute/relative/angular tolerances, options/default source, pre/postselection, CPlane/view, settings and plugin context. Explicit options, template defaults and current saved settings are distinct.

Separate source_verified facts (source/version/page or URL and observed contract), fixture_observed behavior (binary/input/results) and OM9_decision (chosen policy/threshold/migration). An unknown default stays unresolved until verified or explicitly chosen as OM9 policy.

Compare the current FreeCAD native UI/API/backend and OM9 adapter ownership/lifecycle against that exact contract. Reuse a primitive only when supported input/type/options/error/transaction semantics meet the slice; API existence is not parity.

Run representative Rhino 5 and FreeCAD/OM9 native fixtures with the same input and recorded context; measure geometry/topology/units/state, cancellation, Undo/Redo and persistence as relevant. Keep failures, unsupported/skipped/not_run and evidence gaps explicit. Update acceptance/status only to the scope actually demonstrated.

evidence_types.source_verified: Guide/help/API location and version support a stated fact; this alone does not show implementation or solver equivalence.
evidence_types.fixture_observed: Native run in a named binary and input/context, with measured outcomes and assertion coverage.
evidence_types.OM9_decision: Deliberate implementation choice, priority, bound, error policy, ownership or migration; do not attribute it to Rhino without a source/fixture.

counts.counts_meaning: Copied ID coverage from current CAPABILITY_LOOKUP; counts are navigation/backlog counts, not completion percentages.
